Privacy Policy – SBOM Manager Lite

Effective Date: July 31, 2025

1. Overview

SBOM Manager Lite is a scoped application for ServiceNow that integrates with the external SBOM Manager Web platform to synchronize Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) data. This privacy policy outlines how data is collected, processed, transmitted, stored, and secured in both environments.

2. Data Collection

The following types of data may be collected and processed:

  • SBOM metadata including software package names, versions, and suppliers
  • SBOM structure and component relationships
  • User or system details initiating the import
  • Timestamps and audit logs related to SBOM activity

3. External Data Processing

SBOMs are initially uploaded and processed on the external SBOM Manager Web platform, which is hosted outside of the ServiceNow infrastructure. During this processing step, data is parsed, normalized, and prepared for synchronization.

4. Data Synchronization with ServiceNow

After processing, the relevant SBOM data is securely transmitted to your ServiceNow instance via API-based integration. Only essential data required for operational use within ServiceNow is synchronized.

5. Data Security

All data transmissions between SBOM Manager Web and ServiceNow are encrypted using industry-standard protocols (e.g., HTTPS/TLS). The external platform employs strict security controls, access policies, and auditing mechanisms to ensure data integrity and confidentiality. Within ServiceNow, data is stored and protected according to ServiceNow's native security model, including ACLs and role-based access.

6. Data Sharing

No SBOM data is shared with third-party systems beyond the SBOM Manager Web platform and your ServiceNow instance. Data remains under the control of the customer at all times.

7. Compliance

The application follows best practices in data protection and privacy and is designed to support compliance with applicable data privacy regulations, including GDPR and CCPA. All data handling is documented, transparent, and limited to what is necessary for functionality.

8. Contact

If you have questions regarding this privacy policy or your data, please contact us at:

Email: info@eracent.com
